newsitem.title: CANADA: Czech leader to visit Canada.
newsitem.headline: Czech leader to visit Canada.

text.p: Czech Prime Minister Vaclav Klaus will visit Canada this month, Canadian Prime Minister Jean Chretien announced on Monday.
He will meet Chretien and then travel to Toronto and Alberta during the Feb. 20-23 visit at the head of a business delegation.

A statement from Chretien's office said bilateral trade has grown to C$160 million ($120 million) in 1996 from C$138 million in 1995. Canadians have invested approximately C$150 million in the Czech republic.
